title: Majority coalition split equivalence
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, there is a bijection between sign assignments on $k+m$ coordinates and pairs consisting of a sign assignment on $k$ coordinates and one on $m$ coordinates. The bijection splits an assignment into its first $k$ and last $m$ coordinates, and its inverse concatenates the two assignments.
